$comment: The one seam registry: every hook the plugin calls (hooks) and every other config key (settings). schemas/ds-config.schema.json and skills/setup/references/seam-registry.md are generated from it by scripts/build-config-schema.py --write; never edit those two by hand.

hooks.payload: the delta payload as a fenced JSON block (docs-hooks.md, The delta payload)
hooks.verdict: check: PASS or FAIL with the fix; update: the pages changed and where they went
hooks.unset: no documentation system registered; every docs phase reports itself skipped
stepVerdict: UPDATE DOCS: PUBLISHED | STAGED | CURRENT | NOT CONFIGURED | FAILED
UPDATE DOCS CHECK: PASS | FAIL | NOT CONFIGURED

hooks.payload: the delta payload, live: true for publish
hooks.verdict: check: PASS or FAIL with the fix; publish and draft: where the note is
hooks.unset: release notes cannot be requested; --release-notes reports itself unavailable
stepVerdict: RELEASE NOTES: PUBLISHED | DRAFTED | NOT CONFIGURED | FAILED

hooks.payload: sync: {docsOutcome, live} as a fenced JSON block (a re-run names `sync` too); check: none (the skill checks its own preconditions)
hooks.verdict: KNOWLEDGE BASE SYNC: DONE | CURRENT | FAILED (plus evidence); FAILED never reverts the documentation push
hooks.unset: no knowledge base registered: the step reports NOT CONFIGURED and the release continues
stepVerdict: KNOWLEDGE BASE SYNC: DONE | CURRENT | FAILED | NOT RUN | NOT CONFIGURED

hooks.verdict: POST-DEPLOY HEALTH: PASS | FAIL | NOT RUN (plus CLOSE-OUT OWED); close-out: POST-DEPLOY CLOSE-OUT: DONE | PARTIAL
hooks.unset: the close-out reports the health check as not configured
stepVerdict: POST-DEPLOY HEALTH: PASS | FAIL | NOT RUN | NOT CONFIGURED

hooks.verdict: RELEASE CLASS: LIGHT | FULL, then a one-line reason
hooks.unset: RELEASE CLASS: FULL — a release is never light by default

hooks.payload: check followed by {productionBranch, releaseSource, head, pullRequest}
hooks.verdict: PRE-MERGE: CLEAR | HOLD | NOT RUN (plus evidence; HOLD states the action first)
hooks.unset: the go-ahead summary and the recap say: pre-merge production check: not configured
stepVerdict: PRE-MERGE: CLEAR | HOLD | NOT RUN | NOT CONFIGURED

hooks.verdict: exit 0 approved and read back; 2 not waiting yet; any other exit STOPS
hooks.unset: the deploy runs without an approval step

hooks.verdict: exit 0 only when production serves RELEASE_COMMIT
hooks.unset: the owner confirms the deploy by hand

hooks.payload: RELEASE_COMMIT in the environment (the head the release merges from the source)
hooks.verdict: exit 0 deployed to the development environment; 2 not deployed yet; 1 the development deploy failed
hooks.unset: the release does not wait for a development deploy

hooks.verdict: the verdict is stdout's first line; exit codes 0-5 per the provider contract
hooks.unset: no clearance: release runs as before and nothing is claimed

hooks.payload: one scrubbed agent session summary as JSON on stdin (itemNumber, sessionId, agent, startedAt, then the optional fields the loop knows)
hooks.verdict: stdout's first line (WROTE, ABSENT, FORBIDDEN, UNREACHABLE, ERROR); exit 0 wrote, 1 anything else; a failure never stops delivery
hooks.unset: no summary: build-item writes nothing and says nothing

hooks.payload: <kind> <key>, then the verb's options (claim: --purpose, --phase, --expiry, --takeover; heartbeat: --phase; release: --outcome; list: --kind); the holder in CLAIM_HOLDER, never on argv
hooks.verdict: stdout's first line (WON, LOST, OK, NOT HOLDER, ABSENT, FORBIDDEN, UNREACHABLE, ERROR), then the claim JSON; exit 0 won or ok, 2 lost, 4 not the holder, 1 anything else
hooks.unset: no claims: build-item selects and builds exactly as before and claims nothing

hooks.payload: none; run from the repository root, in array order
hooks.verdict: exit 0 passes; an error outside generated.paths fails
hooks.unset: push asks for a command; fast story merges stay off

hooks.verdict: exit 0 passes
hooks.unset: the verify.typecheck array is used; this legacy single command is read only when that array is absent

hooks.verdict: exit 0 is green; red is a stop
hooks.unset: no full-suite gate; fast story merges stay off

hooks.payload: <path/to/test> replaced with the file to run
hooks.verdict: exit 0 is green
hooks.unset: the story gate widens to verify.test

hooks.verdict: exit 0 is green
hooks.unset: no lint step

hooks.payload: none; selected by the entry's when and pathGlobs
hooks.verdict: exit 0 is green; red blocks the pull request or the release
hooks.unset: no pre-ship checks: an explicit no-op
stepVerdict: PRE-SHIP SELECTED: <names> | PRE-SHIP: NOTHING TO RUN
PRE-SHIP: PASS (<n> ran, <k> waived) | PRE-SHIP: FAIL <names>

hooks.verdict: exit 0 made the instance
hooks.unset: no isolated instances: the current checkout is the only environment
stepVerdict: LOCAL ENVIRONMENT <verb>: DONE | NOT CONFIGURED | FAILED

hooks.verdict: exit 0 returned the instance to <base>'s schema
hooks.unset: branch-hotfix names the missing command and offers the manual path
stepVerdict: LOCAL ENVIRONMENT <verb>: DONE | NOT CONFIGURED | FAILED

hooks.verdict: stdout is the name of this checkout's instance
hooks.unset: an in-place recreate with <name> stops and asks
stepVerdict: LOCAL ENVIRONMENT <verb>: DONE | NOT CONFIGURED | FAILED

hooks.verdict: exit 0 seeded the instance
hooks.unset: nothing is seeded
stepVerdict: LOCAL ENVIRONMENT <verb>: DONE | NOT CONFIGURED | FAILED

hooks.verdict: exit 0 migrated the instance forward
hooks.unset: nothing is migrated
stepVerdict: LOCAL ENVIRONMENT <verb>: DONE | NOT CONFIGURED | FAILED

hooks.verdict: exit 0 removed the instance
hooks.unset: instances are left for the owner to remove
stepVerdict: LOCAL ENVIRONMENT <verb>: DONE | NOT CONFIGURED | FAILED

hooks.verdict: exit 0 held; exit 2 not held (busy or in use); any other exit is an error; the first stdout line is quoted
hooks.unset: the repository's own lease protocol applies when its conventions declare a pool; otherwise there is no pool and no lease
stepVerdict: LEASE: LEASED <member> | BUSY <member> | NOT CONFIGURED | ERROR

hooks.verdict: exit 0 returned; any other exit is a refusal, quoted and never retried blindly
hooks.unset: nothing is handed back
stepVerdict: RETURN: RETURNED <member> | REFUSED <member> | NOT CONFIGURED | ERROR

hooks.payload: none; run from the repository root
hooks.verdict: stdout's one line is the stage; empty means no stage; non-zero with output, or several lines, is a fault
hooks.unset: no per-environment infrastructure: no stage renders and doctor reports N/A

hooks.payload: <context> replaced with - and the prompt on stdin; <effort>; legacy <base>
hooks.verdict: findings on stdout; a failed run is this-run degradation
hooks.unset: no local CLI engine on the roster

hooks.verdict: advisory findings on stdout
hooks.unset: no read-only support call

hooks.verdict: exit 0 regenerated the build output
hooks.unset: generated files cannot be regenerated by the loop
